title: Espoo, Uusimaa — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Espoo, Uusimaa: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Espoo is a city in Uusimaa with a population of 293,000. A tech-driven city in Greater Helsinki, home to Aalto University and Nokia’s headquarters, surrounded by nature. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
